ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious SYSTEM User Process Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious process creation as SYSTEM user (suspicious program or command line parameter)

sequences.query: (((process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384") AND (user = RGX(".*AUTHORI.*") OR user = RGX(".*AUTORI.*"))) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\forfiles\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\hh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-NoP\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-W\\ Hidden\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-decode\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/decode\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/urlcache\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-urlcache\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ JAB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ SUVYI.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ SQBFAFgA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ aWV4I.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ IAB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ PAA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e*\\ aQBlAHgA.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*vssadmin\\ delete\\ shadows.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\ SAVE\\ HKLM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ma\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Run.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.downloadstring\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.downloadfile\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/ticket\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*dpapi\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*event\\:\\:clear.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*event\\:\\:drop.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*id\\:\\:modify.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*kerberos\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsadump\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*misc\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*privilege\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rpc\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sekurlsa\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sid\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*token\\:\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*vault\\:\\:cred.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*vault\\:\\:list.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ p\\:\\:d\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\;iex\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MiniDump.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*net\\ user\\ .*")))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*ping.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*127\\\.0\\\.0\\\.1.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-n\\ .*")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\PING\\\.EXE$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\DismFoDInstall\\\.cmd.*")) OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Packages\\\\Plugins\\\\Microsoft\\\.GuestConfiguration\\\.ConfigurationforWindows\\\\.*") OR ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Java\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Java\\\\.*")) AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\bin\\\\javaws\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Java\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Java\\\\.*")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\bin\\\\jp2launcher\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ma\\ .*")))
